PAEL.talk.INTERLOPER-INTERLOPER.1-0r.anc: Determination is unlike anything i have seen before...
PAEL.talk.INTERLOPER-INTERLOPER.1-1r.anc: I guess such spire is not anything new.

TEZCATARA.talk.INTERLOPER-INTERLOPER.0-3: Pick something my dear, make it light up a path.
NONUPEIPE.talk.INTERLOPER-INTERLOPER.0-2: tutu~, go ahead and accept my blessing

DARV.talk.INTERLOPER-INTERLOPER.0-3r.anc: Go ahead, you get one for free.
